payload.text:
FINAL MASTER PROMPT – LAND HUB Real Estate Website

Build a high-end, professional real estate website named “LAND HUB” for showcasing land plots and sites for sale in Bengaluru and Kanakapura Road, Karnataka, India.

This website represents a trusted family-run real estate business, so the design must feel honest, premium, calm, and widely appreciated.

🎯 PURPOSE

Display available land plots and sites

Build trust with buyers and investors

Allow visitors to view land details and contact directly

Present the brand as reliable, experienced, and professional

🎨 DESIGN & UI / UX STYLE

Clean, professional real estate design

Premium colors: white, soft grey, deep green, subtle gold accents

Modern typography (clear, readable, elegant)

Spacious layout with calm visuals

No flashy or childish elements

🧊 3D & SCROLL EXPERIENCE (VERY IMPORTANT)

Use smooth scroll-based 3D animations

As the user scrolls:

Land images gently move forward and settle into position

Cards slide in naturally and align perfectly

Subtle depth effect (parallax + 3D layering)

Every image should move smoothly and lock into the correct place

No abrupt motion — slow, elegant, premium movement

🖼 DEFAULT MEDIA CONTENT

Add default high-quality land images:

Open plotted sites

Green surroundings

Road-facing plots

Gated layout visuals

Add default land walkthrough video (silent / soft background music)

Use placeholders that look realistic and professional

🏠 WEBSITE SECTIONS
1. Hero Section

Large professional headline:
“LAND HUB – Trusted Land & Site Experts in Bengaluru”

Sub-text:
Premium sites and land investments in Bengaluru & Kanakapura Road

CTA buttons:

View Available Lands

Contact Now

3D background with land visuals

2. Featured Lands

Cards showing:

Location (Bengaluru / Kanakapura Road)

Plot size

Price (on request or per sq ft)

Smooth hover & scroll motion

3. Land Details Section

Image gallery (scroll-animated)

Default land video embedded

Nearby landmarks

Google map embed

4. Why Choose LAND HUB

Trusted local expertise

Transparent dealings

Clear documentation

Long-term customer relationships

5. About Us

Family-run real estate business

Years of experience in Bengaluru land market

Honest & customer-first approach

6. Contact Section

Simple inquiry form

Call & WhatsApp buttons

Office location

📱 RESPONSIVENESS

Fully responsive on:

Mobile

Tablet

Desktop

Smooth animations adapted for mobile

🧠 BRAND TONE

Professional

Trust-building

Calm & confident

Suitable for families, elders, and investors

FINAL EXPECTATION:
Generate a premium, professional, 3D-enhanced real estate website for LAND HUB that feels trustworthy, elegant, and respected — suitable for a father-owned real estate business, and appreciated by all age groups.

💡 EXTRA TIP (OPTIONAL – ADD AT THE END IF TOOL SUPPORTS IT)

Keep animations subtle and respectful, prioritizing clarity and trust over visual drama.

**Designing LAND HUB**

I'm currently focused on the brand name "LAND HUB" for the high-end real estate website. The target audience is affluent buyers interested in land plots in Bengaluru and Kanakapura Road. I'm prioritizing a premium, calm, and trustworthy design reflecting a family-run business. Key features include a clean UI, specifically white and soft grey color palettes.


**Refining UI Aesthetics**

I'm now integrating deep green and gold accents into the existing white and soft grey color scheme. Exploring 3D and scroll animations is next, aiming for a dynamic visual experience. I plan to use parallax effects and images to enhance the visual appeal, alongside the image placements and videos. Furthermore, sections will include hero, featured lands, land details, why choose us, about us, and contact. Contact buttons (call/WhatsApp) and inquiry form will be made functional, maintaining a responsive design.


**Implementing 3D Effects**

I'm now implementing the 3D layering effect using CSS perspectives and Framer Motion. Color palette details are now finalized as deep green, gold accents, and white/light grey backgrounds. Unsplash URLs will serve as placeholders for the land images. I'm focusing on file updates: `App.tsx` will be rebuilt as the Real Estate landing page, and `index.html` will have the title updated. I'm removing old components and creating new ones specific to the real estate UI. This will effectively transform the existing framework into a new application based on the user's master prompt.

**Revising Project Scope**

I'm now fully aware that the focus has shifted, and I'm actively reassessing the architectural divergence between "Gemini Shader Pilot" and the "LAND HUB" real estate platform. My primary goal now is to recalibrate the initial design principles, ensuring a seamless and efficient transformation of the underlying technology. I'm prioritizing minimal waste in the process.


**Clarifying User Requirements**

I've clarified the user's explicit request for default land plots with 3D animation, mirroring the "unexpected" style. Now, I'm focusing on the Land Hub code within the provided files. I need to integrate the animation within the existing `App.tsx` and `index.html` structure. I've noted that the file structure includes lingering code from the "Shader Pilot" app, which is not the focus. My priority is integrating smooth 3D scroll effects for the default lands.


**Expanding Visuals & Content**

I'm now expanding the "Featured Plots" with richer content, adding realistic plot details. The emphasis is on a premium visual style. I'm focusing on incorporating more sophisticated 3D scroll animations, specifically parallax effects and 3D layering using framer-motion, for enhanced visual depth. The goal is to bring a higher level of user engagement to the site.
